purpose: Teach: 配給/ジャーナリズム/公衆/リアルタイム/真っ赤/隠す/断念/上る

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 災害支援、本気で、絶対、配給、絶対、当社、絶対、ご支援、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I'm serious about this — we need to commit fully to disaster relief distribution. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Clear attack on the opening. Steady pace, no softening. Weight on 「本気で」and 「絶対」. Eyes forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界の、本気で、絶対、ジャーナリズム、絶対、当社、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're monitoring industry journalism closely and we appreciate your guidance on this.
lines.style: Professional acknowledgment, slightly formal. Measured tempo. Respectful but not deferential — owns the commitment. Small nod of understanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、公衆、絶対、向けの、絶対、サービス、絶対、強化しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And I want our public-facing services strengthened. This matters. Make it happen.
lines.style: Firm, direct command without harshness. Slight pause before 「強化しろ」. Conviction underneath. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。販売の、本気で、絶対、リアルタイム、絶対、分析、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're already moving forward with real-time sales analysis. We appreciate your confidence.
lines.style: Calm, competent report. Even pace. Demonstrates preparedness without over-explaining. Professional warmth — not robotic.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品の、本気で、絶対、真っ赤、絶対、な、絶対、パッケージ、絶対、人気だ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The new product's crimson packaging — it's performing well. That's a good sign.
lines.style: Observational, slight note of approval. Conversational drop in tempo. Pride underneath but delivered plainly. Small breath before the assessment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、不正を、絶対、隠す、絶対、ことなく、絶対、透明性を、絶対、保っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We maintain full transparency — we don't hide any mistakes. That's our standard.
lines.style: Steady, firm commitment. Emphasis on 「透明性」. No hedging. Speaks from principle, not just policy. Direct eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、断念、絶対、した、絶対、計画を、絶対、参考にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Study the plans other companies have abandoned. Learn from what doesn't work.
lines.style: Strategic direction, slightly reflective. Slower, deliberate pacing. Wisdom underneath — not punitive. Treats failure as information.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の業績、本気で、絶対、上る、絶対、勢いを、絶対、保ってまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll maintain this upward momentum in our performance. Thank you for your direction.
lines.style: Professional closing. Steady resolve. Gratitude that's genuine, not servile. Slight warmth returning — the meeting drawing to natural close.
